targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and r["_field"] == "total_active_power")
  |> last()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and r["_field"] == "battery_power")
  |> last()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and r["_field"] == "export_power_hybrid")
  |> last()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and r["_field"] == "battery_level")
  |> last()

import "array"
import "math"

pvPower = (from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and r["_field"] == "total_active_power")
  |> mean()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value

battPower = (from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and r["_field"] == "battery_power")
  |> mean()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value

gridPower = (from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and r["_field"] == "export_power_hybrid")
  |> mean()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value

pvToHouse = pvPower - (if battPower > 0.0 then battPower else 0.0) - (if gridPower > 0.0 then gridPower else 0.0)
pvToBatt  = if battPower > 0.0 then battPower else 0.0
pvToGrid  = if gridPower > 0.0 then gridPower else 0.0
gridToHouse = if gridPower < 0.0 then math.abs(x: gridPower) else 0.0
battToHouse = if battPower < 0.0 then math.abs(x: battPower) else 0.0

array.from(rows: [
  {Quelle: "PV Solar", Ziel: "Haus",         "Leistung (W)": if pvToHouse > 0.0 then pvToHouse else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "PV Solar", Ziel: "Batterie",     "Leistung (W)": pvToBatt},
  {Quelle: "PV Solar", Ziel: "Einspeisung",  "Leistung (W)": pvToGrid},
  {Quelle: "Netz",     Ziel: "Haus",         "Leistung (W)": gridToHouse},
  {Quelle: "Batterie", Ziel: "Haus",         "Leistung (W)": battToHouse},
])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "total_active_power" or r["_field"] == "battery_power" or r["_field"] == "export_power_hybrid" or r["_field"] == "load_power_hybrid")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")
